title: Uncover check and attack the queen
text: Ng5 uncovers the rook’s check along the h-file and attacks the queen. Black must answer the check, allowing the knight to capture the queen next.

title: Defend with checkmate
text: Rb1 blocks the queen’s check and opens the bishop’s diagonal to the black king. The discovered check is checkmate.

title: The windmill
text: The rook repeatedly captures a piece and returns to b7 with check. Each discovered bishop check forces the king away; each rook check brings it back. White collects the knight, bishop, and queen.
demonstration: Rxb5+ Ka7 Rb7+ Ka8 Rxb4+ Ka7 Rb7+ Ka8 Rh7+ Kb8 Rxh5
